newsitem.title: ITALY: NATO to hold first major exercise in Spain.
newsitem.headline: NATO to hold first major exercise in Spain.

text.p: Spain will host a major NATO military exercise for the first time next month, the alliance's southern region command said on Friday.

It said the amphibious training exercise, Destined Glory 97, would involve forces from nine countries from April 7 to 20. The exercises are to take place in the western Mediterranean, the Gulf of Cadiz and southern Spain.

"Exercise DG 97, the Southern Region's first major exercise to be held in Spain, is designed to improve NATO's ability to carry out multinational amphibious operations," a statement from the command headquarters in Naples, Italy, said.
Spain joined the NATO alliance in 1986 after a referendum but is not yet part of its integrated military structure.

The country's conservative government has signalled that it plans to complete the step later this year after a NATO summit in Madrid in July. The alliance's secretary-general, Javier Solana, is a former Spanish foreign minister.
NATO sources said Spain had taken part in alliance exercises abroad but next month's training would be "the first of significant dimensions" on its own soil.
"It is partly a signal of the approaching integration," one source said.

The statement said Spanish officers would command a multinational Amphibious Task Force and a Landing Force for the exercise. It will involve air, naval and amphibious forces from Britain, France, Germany, Greece, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, Turkey and the United States.
